chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī wrote to Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, saying: It has been narrated from the Righteous Ones عليهم السلام: “Circumcise your children on the seventh day so that they may be purified, for the earth cries out to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, because of the urine of the uncircumcised.”

May Allah make me your ransom, but the barbers in our town are not skilled in that, and they do not circumcise him on the seventh day. We have a barber from the Jews; is it permissible for the Jews to circumcise the children of the Muslims, or not?
So he عليه السلام wrote back: “On the seventh day; so do not oppose the sunnah (prophetic tradition), if Allah wills.”

key_terms.أَوْلَادَكُمْ: Your children; the subject of the ruling.
key_terms.اخْتِنُوا: Circumcise; the instruction to perform circumcision.
key_terms.السُّنَنَ: The sunnah (prophetic tradition); the normative practice not to be opposed.
key_terms.الْأَغْلَفِ: The uncircumcised; the one whose urine is mentioned in the report.
key_terms.الْيَهُودِ: The Jews; referring here to the non-Muslim practitioner being asked about.
key_terms.يَطَّهَّرُوا: They may be purified; indicating purification associated with the act.
key_terms.يَوْمَ السَّابِعِ: The seventh day; the recommended time mentioned for circumcision.

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a Jewish practitioner to circumcise Muslim children, and should circumcision be done on the seventh day?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns the circumcision of children on the seventh day and emphasizes adherence to the sunnah (prophetic tradition) in this matter. It also records a legal inquiry about whether a Jewish practitioner may perform circumcision for Muslim children, with the Imam عليه السلام stressing observance of the prescribed timing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4725 - Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari wrote to Imam Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali (as), saying:
"It has been narrated from the Righteous Ones (peace be upon them) that they said: 'Circumcise your children on the seventh day so they may be purified, for the earth complains to Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, about the urine of the uncircumcised.'

May Allah make me your ransom, but the barbers in our region are not skilled in this, and they do not circumcise on the seventh day. However, we have a barber who is a Jew. Is it permissible for the Jews to circumcise Muslim children or not?"
Imam (as) replied: "On the seventh day - do not oppose the Sunnah, God willing."
